_meta.anti_fabrication_note: Otway-Rees protocol from the 1987 SIGOPS paper. Replay vulnerability identified by BAN 1990 analysis Section 4.2 and Mao-Boyd 1993.
_meta.primary_source: Otway, D.; Rees, O. Efficient and Timely Mutual Authentication. ACM SIGOPS OSR 21(1):8-10, Jan 1987. DOI:10.1145/24592.24594

cryptographic_parameters: I = conversation identifier (integer). K_AS = long-term key between A and S. K_BS = long-term key between B and S. K_AB = session key generated by S. Na, Nb = nonces from A and B.
original_equations:
A → B   : I, A, B, {Na, I, A, B}K_AS
B → S   : I, A, B, {Na, I, A, B}K_AS, {Nb, I, A, B}K_BS
S → B   : I, {Na, K_AB}K_AS, {Nb, K_AB}K_BS
B → A   : I, {Na, K_AB}K_AS

normalized_equations.message: I, A, B, {Na, I, A, B}K_AS
normalized_equations.description: A sends conversation ID I, identities, and an encrypted nonce blob to B.

normalized_equations.message: I, A, B, {Na, I, A, B}K_AS, {Nb, I, A, B}K_BS
normalized_equations.description: B forwards A's blob to S and adds its own nonce blob.
S generates K_AB, sends encrypted key to both parties.
B forwards A's portion. A decrypts and recovers K_AB.

message_1: A → B : I, A, B, {Na, I, A, B}K_AS
message_2: B → S : I, A, B, {Na, I, A, B}K_AS, {Nb, I, A, B}K_BS

complete_message_flow.message: I, A, B, {Na, I, A, B}K_AS
I, A, B, {Na, I, A, B}K_AS, {Nb, I, A, B}K_BS

attack_trace:
Precondition: E has recorded a previous step-4 message: {Na_old, K_AB_old}K_AS

Step 1: E → A : I, {Na_old, K_AB_old}K_AS
         E replays the old step-4 message to A with the same conversation ID I.
         A decrypts and recovers Na_old which matches what A sent in the original session.
         A accepts K_AB_old as the current session key.
Outcome: A uses a stale session key K_AB_old that E may know.
security_violation: The conversation identifier I and nonce Na alone do not prevent replay of step-4 from a previous session. A has no way to verify that the session key K_AB was freshly generated by S for the current session. BAN analysis shows A cannot conclude K_AB is fresh.
verified_by: REQUIRES_MANUAL_VERIFICATION — confirm exact equation notation from original SIGOPS 1987 paper p.8
notes: Original protocol from Otway-Rees 1987. Replay vulnerability identified in BAN 1990 Section 4.2. The protocol has multiple described vulnerabilities; the replay of step 4 is the most cited. A corrected version by Mao and Boyd (1993) adds a server-freshness nonce.
